# strettchcloud_compute (Resource)

A Strettch Cloud compute instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "strettchcloud_specification" "medium" {
  vcpus     = 2
  memory_mb = 4096
}

resource "strettchcloud_compute" "web" {
  host_name      = "web-01"
  image          = "UBUNTU-24.04"
  region         = "KGL-1"
  specification  = data.strettchcloud_specification.medium.specification
  public_keys    = ["ssh-ed25519 AAAA..."]
  with_public_ip = true
  tags           = ["production", "web"]
  # state defaults to "RUNNING"; set "STOPPED" to keep it powered off.
}

output "ip" {
  value = strettchcloud_compute.web.ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_name` (String) Host name. Updated in place. Must be non-empty with no leading or trailing whitespace.
- `image` (String) Image slug, e.g. `UBUNTU-24.04`. Changing it replaces the compute. Catalog validity is checked by the API.
- `public_keys` (Set of String) SSH public keys. Cannot change after creation (changing them replaces the compute). Not recoverable on import; the first apply after import writes them in place without a replace.
- `region` (String) Region slug, e.g. `KGL-1`. Changing it replaces the compute. Catalog validity is checked by the API.
- `specification` (String) Specification slug, e.g. `S-1C-1G`. Raising it resizes the compute in place (upward only; downsizing is an error). The compute is stopped during the resize.

### Optional

- `state` (String) Desired power state: `RUNNING` or `STOPPED`. Updated in place via start/stop. Defaults to `RUNNING`. Not sent on create; every new compute starts.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags. Updated in place. Each tag must be non-empty with no leading or trailing whitespace.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `with_public_ip` (Boolean) Whether to attach a public IP. Cannot change after creation (changing it replaces the compute). Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Compute id.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `private_ipv4` (String) Private IPv4 address.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing compute by its id. The first apply after import plans an
# in-place update on public_keys (never a replace); set public_keys in config to
# match the key the compute was created with.
terraform import strettchcloud_compute.web 325
```
